---
title: "Gochujang noodles"
author: "[Hello Fresh](https://www.hellofresh.co.uk/recipes/sesame-gochujang-veggie-noodles-646b7beb22f7f34e1f95d055)"
categories: [noodles]
description: Super quick and tasty
---

* 80g green beans
* 80g pea pods
* 120g mushrooms
* 120g pak choi
* 2 nests of noodles
* 50g ketjap manis
* 15ml soy sauce
* 75ml water 

1. Fry mushrooms
1. Add greenbeans, pod, pak choi,
1. Add liquids and bring to a sauce
1. Serve with noodles
